The candidate list contains five releases in the period; I’m retrieving the Wikipedia discography page to distinguish studio recordings from other album types.
```python
page_text = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes_Sosa_discography", max_chars=20000)
print(page_text)
```
The direct page lookup did not return a visible result, so I’m using Wikipedia’s album-category search and the artist page as a fallback to verify the release classifications.
```python
wiki_check = await wikipedia_search("Mercedes Sosa albums Misa Criolla Acústico Argentina quiere cantar Corazón libre Cantora", max_results=10)
print(wiki_check)
```
Wikipedia’s period list includes “Argentina quiere cantar,” but that release is live; the studio-album entries are “Misa Criolla” (2000), “Acústico” (2002), “Corazón libre” (2005), and “Cantora” (2009). I’m doing one final targeted Wikipedia check for whether “Cantora” is counted as one album or separate volumes in the 2022-era discography.
```python
final_check = await web_search("site:en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes_Sosa_discography \"Studio albums\" \"Cantora\" \"Corazón libre\"", max_results=5)
print(final_check)
```
4
